items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，如Content-Type 标头中指定。

items.source: Set the hint with the given name to the given value for SmartHttpMessageConverters supporting them.
items.translation: 将具有给定名称的提示设置为给定值，以支持它们的`SmartHttpMessageConverter`。

items.source: Set the body of the request to the given function that writes to an OutputStream.
items.translation: 将请求体设置为给定函数，该函数写入到 `OutputStream`。

items.source:
Set the body of the request to the given Object. For example: 
Person person = ... ;
ResponseEntity<Void> response = client.post()
    .uri("/persons/{id}", id)
    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .body(person)
    .retrieve()
    .toBodilessEntity();
items.translation:
将请求体设置为给定的 `Object`。 例如： 
Person person = ... ;
ResponseEntity<Void> response = client.post()
    .uri("/persons/{id}", id)
    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .body(person)
    .retrieve()
    .toBodilessEntity();

items.source: Set the body of the request to the given Object. The parameter bodyType is used to capture the generic type.
items.translation: 将请求体设置为给定的 `Object`。 参数 `bodyType` 用于捕获泛型类型。

items.source: Set the body of the request to the given Object.
items.translation: 将请求的主体设置为给定的Object。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: body - a function that takes an OutputStream and can throw an IOException
items.translation: body - 一个接受 OutputStream 并可抛出 IOException 的函数

items.source: key - the key of the hint to add
value - the value of the hint to add
Contract for specifying request headers and body leading up to the exchange.
items.translation: 用于指定交换之前请求标头和正文的合约。

items.source: bodyType - the type of the body, used to capture the generic type
items.translation: bodyType - 实体的类型，用于捕获泛型类型。
